snippet.title: Escape from Spikes Level - 2 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Escape From Spikes is a platformer that will test your patience from time to time. It looks easy to play but you will see that it is not. Good Luck.

Steam Store
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864860/Escape_from_Spikes/

Rules are Simple

Collect the Gems. Take the key and open the door. Watch out for Spikes while doing so.

Rules

Spikes will kill you.
You have 3 + 1 Life per level.
Collect the gold.
Get the key.
Open the exit door.
